findings.summary: The mandated mechanical product-consistency diff between implementation_subject_commit and subject_commit (excluding .dev-dispatch) could not be executed: this reviewer has read-only file inspection and no shell or Git execution. Consistency was assessed by reading the checked-out product files plus the committed .dev-dispatch handoff and review records, all of which agree on implementation_subject_commit f92849ff66e3d6dfa704a065a5fe0bdd97395dd9; no product discrepancy was observed.

Metadata-only observation: the committed implement handoff records work_head_commit 0fd39ccd9743a7c24164d55b3186ed8389df8a2b, while the dispatch context names f92849ff66e3d6dfa704a065a5fe0bdd97395dd9 as the product commit. Consistent with the implement materializer stacking a metadata-only commit on the actor's product commit; no product file is affected.
